## Notes from earlier work
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0001] Round money only with round_money: Always round monetary Decimal results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 3x, 2 passed, 1 failed)
- [at-0008] Refunds above 500.00 need approved_by: Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 require a second approver per FIN-2026-03: accept keyword-only `approved_by=None` and raise `BillingError("approval_required")` when the amount exceeds the threshold and `approved_by` is missing; amounts at or below 500.00 need no approval.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source FIN-2026-03; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0002] Coerce unit prices with to_money: In ledgerly/invoice.py, coerce line unit prices via ledgerly.money.to_money before multiplying by quantity, and accumulate sums starting from ledgerly.money.ZERO, as line_total and invoice_total do.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0005] Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).
  (learned from task E03 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0006] Compute periods via floor division: Compute billing period boundaries with `timedelta(days=sub.period_days)` and floor division `(at - start) // length`, mirroring `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`.
  (learned from task E03 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0007] Money-moving functions take keyword-only idempotency_key: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it first, before state validation: scan `audit.events(<event_type>)` for a matching `idempotency_key` and return the original record without reapplying. Pass `idempotency_key` into the `audit.record(...)` call.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source INC-204; relied on 1x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
